links.outcome: Gene prediction classifier accuracy with vs without image-quality filtering
links.effect: Filtering images with Retinograd-AI raised gene prediction classifier accuracy from 33.8% to 68.9%.
links.quote: Applying Retinograd-AI to filter images improved the accuracy of a gene prediction classifier from 33.8% to 68.9%.

unlisted_practices: Automated image gradability/quality assessment as an upstream gate for downstream AI pipelines

screen.reason: Evaluates an automated image gradability quality filter and demonstrates that filtering out poor-quality images improves downstream AI gene prediction accuracy from 33.8% to 68.9%.

primary.practice: automated input image quality filtering before downstream AI classification
